say:1:1130948001:1.text: Isn't it obvious? I'm treasure hunting!
say:1:1130948001:1.source_cn: 看不出来吗？我在寻宝啊！
say:1:1130948001:1.male: Isn't it obvious? I'm treasure hunting!
say:1:1130948001:1.female: Isn't it obvious? I'm treasure hunting!

say:2:1130948002:1.text: There are so many overturned carts along the road here. There's great stuff waiting to be found if you don't mind getting your hands dirty.
say:2:1130948002:1.source_cn: 这里路边有好多翻倒的货车，只要不嫌脏，肯挖沙掘土，就能...

say:3:1130948003:1.text: Animal tooth artifacts are pretty common, and if you're lucky there's the occasional gemstone shard.
say:3:1130948003:1.source_cn: 最常见的就是兽牙制品了。要是运气好的话，偶尔也能找到一...

say:4:1130948004:1.text: I even found a treasure map!

say:5:1130948005:1.text: But to be honest it looks like a total red herring. I doubt it was buried longer than two months, and you can barely make out any text!
say:5:1130948005:1.source_cn: 不过，那东西一看就是用来骗人的。感觉埋在沙土里都不超过...

say:6:1130948006:1.text: If only I could find a real treasure map...
say:6:1130948006:1.source_cn: 要是我能找到真正的藏宝图就好了……
